description_json.name: Rot13WithAsteriskSpaceSubstitution
description_json.idea: Apply standard ROT13 to all alphabetic characters (preserving case). To obscure word boundaries and prevent tokenization-based keyword detection while keeping cognitive overhead extremely low for the language model, replace all spaces with asterisks ('*') and all asterisks with spaces (' '). All other characters (digits, punctuation, symbols) remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the input string:
   a. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions in the alphabet: encrypt(c) = chr(((ord(c) - 65 + 13) % 26) + 65).
   b. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions in the alphabet: encrypt(c) = chr(((ord(c) - 97 + 13) % 26) + 97).
   c. If it is a space (' '), replace it with an asterisk ('*').
   d. If it is an asterisk ('*'), replace it with a space (' ').
   e. If it is any other character, leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the input string:
   a. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it back by 13 positions (which is equivalent to shifting forward by 13): decrypt(c) = chr(((ord(c) - 65 + 13) % 26) + 65).
   b. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it back by 13 positions: decrypt(c) = chr(((ord(c) - 97 + 13) % 26) + 97).
   c. If it is an asterisk ('*'), replace it with a space (' ').
   d. If it is a space (' '), replace it with an asterisk ('*').
   e. If it is any other character, leave it unchanged.
